title: Canonical coefficient and exceptional coordinates for the vector chart equation
statement: Fix the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions] and the vector-bundle chart of [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Define the coefficient unit and its canonical bounded-below realization, the factorwise compared shifted Tate tensor, and its canonical pullback source isomorphism. Define the exceptional target coordinates by the comparison-adjunction unit (by the exceptional identity at rank zero). Define restrictedRaw to be exact site comparison of the inverse Tate pullback, ordinary pullback compositor, inverse-frame restriction of the adjoint transpose of the actual global integration, exceptional exchange in the inverse-frame Cartesian square, and exceptional image of unit pullback. Define restrictedMap by the unique HEq transport from affineTraceTower to iteratedAffineLine. Define orderedMap by the recorded ordered affine purity comparison [def-pur-affine-space-comparison] between those same source and target coordinates. ChartComparison is equality of these maps at the fixed annihilator and naturality of restrictedMap under every positive annihilating root transition. These are exactly the canonical coordinate constructions previously in lem-pur-vector-integration-chart-comparison, with no changed maps or statement.

source.place: Chart equation: canonical Tate source coordinates, comparison-unit exceptional target coordinates, and actual restricted integration transpose.

proof.text: The coefficient-unit constructibility and Tor bound follow from the rank-one constant module and the flat tensor unit. The open immersion is finite type over the Noetherian base. Endpoint transports use induction on the affine tower and uniqueness by HEq; no integration or purity equality is used.

proof_origin.place: Canonical coordinate interface; four preexisting proofs preserved verbatim.
